Title: A field of an existing record is changed, kept after reloading and restored
Step Action: Open the first record of the kind of the row from its list.
Step Expected: The page opens without an error.

Step Action: Note the current value of the field of the row.
Enter the value of the row and click Save.
Reload the page and read the field.
Step Expected: The field shows the new value.

Step Action: Put the original value back and save.

Title: An invalid value in an existing record blocks the save
Step Action: Open the first record of the kind of the row from its list.
Step Expected: The page opens without an error.

Step Action: Enter the invalid or empty value in the field of the row.
Click Save.
Check that the record was not saved.
Step Expected: The page stays on the form.

Step Action: Check the page after the action.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Step Action: Open Manage Contracts > Customers and the Viewers page of the first participant.

Click Add.

Count the selected viewers.
